/.text: The old feed listed all 157 Documents, including the two About Pages, so the homepage advertised 'Showing 1 to 4 of 157 results'. Pages have no place in a chronological feed, so the count is now 155.

/posts.text: Same as '/': the two About Pages no longer appear in the feed.

/posts/how-to-build-newsletter-subscribe.og_image: posts/107.md has 'image: ""', which the old site turned into <meta property="og:image" content="http://localhost"> — pointing social networks at the homepage's HTML as though it were an image. The tag is now omitted when there is no image.

*.og_image: 141 Documents pointed 'image:' at /src/content/images/default_image.jpeg — an Astro-era path for a file that has never existed in this repository, so every share of them showed a broken card. The dead lines are gone. Those Documents now use a social card drawn at build time, or no og:image at all when no font is installed to draw one.
